capabilityLevels.LEVEL_0: Current published series snapshot only; historical release/publication identity is not recoverable from the collector payload.
capabilityLevels.LEVEL_1: Official publication dates are known, but the exact value-as-published artifact is unavailable.
capabilityLevels.LEVEL_2: Official archived release artifacts can support row-by-row value-as-published reconstruction after exact parsing, hashing, and timestamp validation.
capabilityLevels.LEVEL_3: Machine-readable official vintage series supports reproducible point-in-time reconstruction for the exact series.

globalFinding.reason: The current BLS API and DOL XML batch contains latest/current-revised values with conservative retrieval-time bounds, not value-as-published release artifacts.

required: valid time, public time, retrieval time, and acceptance time
forbiddenSubstitutes: crawler or HTTP retrieval time as an official timestamp
current API value substituted for a rounded archived-release value
